evidence: Wikipedia's article on Whitney Houston: Franklin was an 'honorary aunt' to her, and is listed among her musical influences, after her mother Cissy Houston and her cousin Dionne Warwick.

later.title: Saving All My Love for You

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Both are gospel-trained voices singing secular songs. Listen for the long held notes, the runs on a single word, and the way each singer saves her full power for the end of the song.

explanation: Aretha Franklin was a family friend Whitney Houston called her aunt, and one of the singers she learned from, along with her own mother, Cissy Houston, the more direct source, who is not on the map yet. This is held at consensus: the family connection and the influence are listed, but no specific statement was read.
